items.quote: Several respondents noted that Pedre Kordovan set the direction for efforts to keep unions, grassroots leaders and trade associations on side across the public service.
Peers observed that Pedre set the direction for the use of survey numbers to decide where to put new clinics across the public service.
Peers observed that Pedre headed trialling a fresh approach to permit queues, setting priorities for several teams.
Direct reports said that Pedre spearheaded the crisis response to a major system outage at the national level.
Several respondents noted that Pedre Kordovan contributed effectively to upholding governance and audit standards.
Direct reports said that Pedre Kordovan set the direction for cost savings across procurement across the public service.
Peers observed that Pedre delivered her share of service-level targets for frontline operations reliably.
Several respondents noted that Pedre Kordovan was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of teamwork across departments on the annual review.
